prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-darlok-homeworld.png. Requested dimensions 1920x1080, 16:9. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
10 · Darlok — Nazin — blood red / black
Game role: master spies. Strengths: spies cost half and are far better at stealing and catching; sharp computers. Weakness: every race (except Humans) starts uneasy toward them. They trade in secrets.
Body & dress: a hooded, shape-shifting figure — the face is mostly shadow, only a suggestion of a sleek, sinuous visage and two small red eyes; layered dark cloaks with a wet-silk sheen, concealed blades, small silver clasps shaped like keys or eyes. Hands rarely seen; gloves.
Surroundings: shadowy: narrow candle-and-neon back-rooms, one-way mirrors, curtained alcoves, dossier walls with red string and pinned photos, ventilation fog, rain on dark glass, a single red-lit lamp; data-slates tucked everywhere.
Personality: polite, patient, never quite honest. Moods: velvet courtesy → faintly amused menace → unnervingly still.
Hooks: several silhouettes blurred behind them (the leader may be someone else), a door that is slightly ajar, a hand holding a coin that isn't there.
Asset purpose: Homeworld orbital view. Photorealistic planetary orbital view using the race homeworld description. Original believable space infrastructure reflecting culture. No people. No giant decorative emblems. Astronomical camera rather than shallow portrait focus.
Composition: Planet occupies lower-left half; right 35% and top 20% remain predominantly dark space, sparse stars only, for overlays. Keep focal surface features crop-safe. Small orbital stations and ships close to the limb; no large ships on right.
World: Nazin: dusky planet, dark rainclouds, scattered red lights, hidden orbital stations.
Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
